analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($357.61) vs SMA5 ($345.68)/SMA20 ($359.32)/SMA50 ($379.76): below short-term, below mid-term, below long-term trend levels.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($392.86)/SMA200 ($368.39): below mid-long term trend, below long-term trend levels.
· 52-week position (33.0%) + recovery phase from historical lows at current price level.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.2→45.5) + confirmed exit from oversold, entering neutral zone + upward momentum maintained.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0960→-0.3689) + worsening, diagnosed as bearish convergence + trend reversal signal unconfirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $359.32) + interpreted as normal band width of 10.90%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($356.43) + based on pivot.
· Swing resistance ($359.49) + confirmation of mid-band breakout upon breach.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low recovery initiation) + potential for bullish trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.74x) + increased confidence in the move.
· Current phase diagnosis (attempting bullish trend reversal after accumulation phase) + buy entry conditions met.
